# Distributor Program

Become a Lavani distributor by filling the enquiry form.

Our sales team will contact you within three business days.

# Frequently Asked Questions

## How can I contact support?

Email: support@lavanistore.in

Phone: +91-9876543210

## Do you ship internationally?

Currently, we ship only within India(Delhi NCR).

# Products

Lavani offers:

- Protein Powder
- Mass Gainer
- Multivitamins
- Whey Protein
- Creatine

# Return Policy

Customers can return products within 7 days of delivery.

Returned products must be unopened and unused.

Refunds are processed within 5 business days after inspection.

# Shipping Policy

Orders are dispatched within 24 hours.

Delivery usually takes 3–5 business days.

Free shipping is available for orders above ₹999.
